findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 2, Harm 4
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - A client pinned to pytest 8 runs `pytest tests/unit && pytest tests/integration`, requires `tests/integration/test_api.py`, and changes that file and another integration test.
The repair assigns the required file to the integration step, but `pytest_tests` still appends it to that step's existing directory argument (`fasttest.py:826` and `fasttest.py:132`). The resulting `pytest tests/integration ... tests/integration/test_api.py` can collect only the explicitly named file on pytest 8, silently omitting the other selected test while the check passes, as shown in the [pytest issue](https://github.com/pytest-dev/pytest/issues/13494). The prior duplicate-execution finding also remains on pytest 7: its [collector](https://docs.pytest.org/en/7.1.x/_modules/_pytest/main.html) collects the explicitly passed file again after the directory. The new test uses the repository's pytest 9 environment and has no second selected integration file.
findings.title: Select pytest files separately for each pytest step

stop.reason: Harm 3 finding: one more round by the standing rule. Give each always_test file only to the plain pytest step whose path arguments contain it (a step with no path arguments takes every one); a file no step contains goes to the first plain pytest step.
